Resubmitting the verdict with a separate search recorded for each item.

I submitted the verdict as verified: I found no test implementing any of the five plan items.

The search was by keyword across `src/`, mainly the mailbox tests under `src/integration/test_suites` and the testbench. It was not exhaustive. I did not trace every test's stimulus, so a test that covers one of these behaviours under different wording could have been missed.

- **Lock on reset deassertion (`cp_09b1804b6739`):** no test checks it. The hitless test calls `mcu_mbox_clear_lock_out_of_reset` but does not check the lock state.
- **Valid user CSR with LOCK set and parameter not enabled (`cp_524f95c33ab7`):** the valid-user and write-user-lock tests enable valid users through `mcu_cptra_init_d`. None covers the parameter-disabled case.
- **Randomized MCU LSU AXI USER (`cp_56c553b219c0`):** no match. The valid-user test randomizes the SoC valid-user list, not the MCU LSU AXI USER.
- **SRAM readable only by MCU and Target (`cp_70f5e9d8cba4`):** no test checks it.
- **SOC Data available interrupt on MCU EXECUTE (`cp_7e15eab8e3fc`):** this is the least certain item. `smoke_test_mcu_hitless` waits for that interrupt (line 152), but only after the SoC BFM agent writes the data. No test has the MCU hold the lock, set EXECUTE and then check the interrupt.

The first submission was rejected because I had recorded only one search for five verified items. I resubmitted with one search per item and it was accepted.
